Jules (AE): dropping Stratus POC redlines. procurement asks: net45, PO before countersign, test-data deletion clause, and HSM attestation in MSA. attaching redline.
Kim - Legal: quick q - any PHI/regulated data? which Redwood entity will sign?
Jules (AE): no PHI, just customer PII; Redwood US to sign. procurement pressed for HSM-level attestation.
Ravi (SE): note: Hosted supports customer-managed keys (procedural attestation). hardware HSM attestation available only on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS.
Nora (Presales): option: offer 30-day Dedicated trial for POC to satisfy HSM attestation and tighten p95 latency. increases cost slightly.
Ben (Finance): net45 ok for POC but we require PO + billing contact before countersign. invoice to "Stratus AP"; first invoice after month 1.
Kim - Legal: redline hotspots: SLA (they want p95 <150ms), KMS indemnity/warranty, and subprocessor disclosure for embeddings vendor. need vendor list and data flow.
Jules (AE): procurement also wants sign flow: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Redwood Exec, countersign within 3 business days.
Kim - Legal: propose compromise language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet agreed latency SLOs; where Customer requires a firm p95 SLA, parties will execute a Dedicated deployment addendum specifying the SLA and remedies." ok?
Ravi (SE): agree. also add automatic routing/fallback clause to move traffic to Dedicated if latency degrades.
SignBot: ACTIONS:
- Legal (Kim) to draft MSA reply with Dedicated-addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Ravi) to attach perf matrix and Dedicated trial cost estimate (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Jules) to obtain PO, billing contact, and signer names from Stratus procurement (ETA today).
- Finance (Ben) to confirm invoice flow and net45 on orderform (ETA EOD).
Jules (AE): pinging procurement now. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree.
Kim - Legal: :thumbsup:
